name: Disqus profile page and users API
tier_rationale: Disqus, Inc., an established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted); P116 FC9.

reliability.justification: The platform's own answer is authoritative for the existence and public fields of its accounts; profile fields (names, links, bios) are self-declared by the owner.

disqus.description: Disqus API public key of the team's own Disqus application (users/details lookups)

profile_page.title: Disqus profile page (disqus.com/by/{username}/)

terms.quote: P116 FC4 (binding council text): documented public APIs (Chess.com PubAPI, Lichess, Mojang, Steam Community XML, Medium RSS, Pinterest widget, Stack Exchange API, Twitch Helix with the team's app) are 'open' once recorded; Snapchat __NEXT_DATA__ and the Disqus profile page are 'unknown' and stay disabled in every profile until legal records them (A1).

profile_page.notes: Research C0265: the page gives existence (<title>Disqus Profile - {u}</title>) and window.home_config is_private only; a 404 with Disqus's 'Page not found' title = ABSENT. Terms 'unknown' until legal records them (P116 FC4).

users_api.title: Disqus API users/details.json with the team's public key

terms.quote: P116 FC4 (binding council text): documented public APIs (Chess.com PubAPI, Lichess, Mojang, Steam Community XML, Medium RSS, Pinterest widget, Stack Exchange API, Twitch Helix with the team's app) are 'open' once recorded; Snapchat __NEXT_DATA__ and the Disqus profile page are 'unknown' and stay disabled in every profile until legal records them (A1).

users_api.notes: Optional key 'disqus' (V3LUM_DISQUS_PUBLIC_KEY): code 0 = FOUND, code 2 ('does not exist') = ABSENT, codes 4/5/9/11/12 (missing/invalid key) = NEEDS_KEY, never absent (P116 FC7); codes 13/14/19 = RATE_LIMITED (1000 req/h per key, documented). Terms class not recorded by the council: 'unknown' until legal reviews the API terms.

notes: Batch p3-G05-2 (P116 disqus_profile). API limit 1000 requests/hour per key (documented, far above the one request per profile URL this module sends).
